scientific_integrity: Analytical finite-census observational-alias theorem with exact recurrence proof, two simple roots and an open-neighborhood argument; no inference about infinite-horizon structural identifiability.
scientific_limitations: The 1935 primary publisher confirms September 1935, while a secondary bibliographic index supplies September 1; the day is not independently confirmed by the publisher.
The complete original 1935 text was inaccessible and general identifiability methods could imply the result.
title: Robust four-census host-only parameter aliases in the Nicholson–Bailey model
